parameters.specification/query:
EVALUATE
VAR _ReportDate  = [MaxDate]
VAR _ReportYear  = YEAR(_ReportDate)
VAR _ReportMonth  = MONTH(_ReportDate)

RETURN
CALCULATETABLE (
    UNION (
        ROW (
            "Category", "Overall",
            "Total Cases", FORMAT ( [CI Total Cases], "#,##0" ),
            "Current CI", FORMAT ( [CI MTD], "0.00" ),
            "Normalized CI", FORMAT ( [CI Normalized], "0.00" ),
            "Target CI", FORMAT ( [CI Target], "0.00" )
        ),
        ROW (
            "Category", "Tech",
            "Total Cases", FORMAT ( CALCULATE ( [CI Total Cases], KEEPFILTERS ( 'CI'[Type0] = "Tech" ) ), "#,##0" ),
            "Current CI", FORMAT ( CALCULATE ( [CI MTD], KEEPFILTERS ( 'CI'[Type0] = "Tech" ) ), "0.00" ),
            "Normalized CI", FORMAT ( CALCULATE ( [CI Normalized], KEEPFILTERS ( 'CI'[Type0] = "Tech" ) ), "0.00" ),
            "Target CI", FORMAT ( CALCULATE ( [CI Target], KEEPFILTERS ( 'CI'[Type0] = "Tech" ) ), "0.00" )
        ),
        ROW (
            "Category", "Non-Tech",
            "Total Cases", FORMAT ( CALCULATE ( [CI Total Cases], KEEPFILTERS ( 'CI'[Type0] = "Non-Tech" ) ), "#,##0" ),
            "Current CI", FORMAT ( CALCULATE ( [CI MTD], KEEPFILTERS ( 'CI'[Type0] = "Non-Tech" ) ), "0.00" ),
            "Normalized CI", FORMAT ( CALCULATE ( [CI Normalized], KEEPFILTERS ( 'CI'[Type0] = "Non-Tech" ) ), "0.00" ),
            "Target CI", FORMAT ( CALCULATE ( [CI Target], KEEPFILTERS ( 'CI'[Type0] = "Non-Tech" ) ), "0.00" )
        )
    ),
    KEEPFILTERS ( YEAR ( 'Date'[Date] ) = _ReportYear ),
    KEEPFILTERS ( MONTH ( 'Date'[Date] ) = _ReportMonth )
)

EVALUATE
TOPN(
    5,
    CALCULATETABLE(
        ADDCOLUMNS(
            VALUES('CI'[CASE_SUB_AREA]),
            "CurrentVal", [CI Total Cases],
            "PrevVal", [CI Total Cases Last Week],
            "Delta", [CI Delta Volume]
        ),
        DATESINPERIOD('Date'[Date], [MaxDate], -7, DAY)
    ),
    [Delta],
    DESC
)
ORDER BY [Delta] DESC

EVALUATE
TOPN(
    5,
    CALCULATETABLE(
        ADDCOLUMNS(
            VALUES('CI'[CASE_CATEGORY]),
            "CurrentVal", [CI Total Cases],
            "PrevVal", [CI Total Cases Last Week],
            "Delta", [CI Delta Volume]
        ),
        DATESINPERIOD('Date'[Date], [MaxDate], -7, DAY)
    ),
    [Delta],
    DESC
)
ORDER BY [Delta] DESC
